# Game Idea: Asteroid Dodge

- **Genre**: Arcade / Action
- **Play area**: HTML5 canvas where asteroids fall from the top.
- **Player**: Small ship that can move horizontally along the bottom and fire lasers.
- **Goal**: Destroy as many asteroids as possible to earn points.
- **Lose condition**: The player loses when an asteroid collides with the ship or reaches the bottom of the canvas.
- **Features**: Gradually increasing fall speed, power‑ups for rapid fire, and a high‑score leaderboard.

A simple, self‑contained canvas game that can be built with vanilla JavaScript.

1: // Simple Asteroid Dodge game
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the HTML
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   // ----- Audio -----
8:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
9:   function playTone(freq, duration) {
10:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
11:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
12:     osc.type = 'sawtooth';
13:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
14:     osc.connect(gain);
15:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
16:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
17:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
18:     osc.start();
19:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
20:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
21:   }
22:   const W = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
23:   const H = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
24:   // ----- Visual Enhancements -----
25:   // starfield background
26:   const stars = [];
27:   for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
28:     stars.push({ x: Math.random() * W, y: Math.random() * H, r: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5 });
29:   }
30:   // explosion particles
31:   const particles = [];
32:   function spawnExplosion(x, y, color) {
33:     // Play explosion sound
34:     playTone(200, 0.2);
35:     for (let i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
36:       particles.push({
37:         x,
38:         y,
39:         vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 3,
40:         vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 3,
41:         life: 30,
42:         color
43:       });
44:     }
45:   }
46: 
47:   // ----- Player -----
48:   const player = {
49:     w: 40,
50:     h: 20,
51:     x: W / 2 - 20,
52:     y: H - 30,
53:     speed: 5,
54:     color: '#0f0',
55:     cooldown: 0
56:   };
57: 
58:   // ----- Game state -----
59:   const asteroids = [];
60:   const lasers = [];
61:   let score = 0;
62:   let gameOver = false;
63: 
64:   // ----- Input handling -----
65:   const keys = {};
66:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
67:     // Resume audio context on first user interaction
68:     if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
69:     keys[e.code] = true;
70:   });
71:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.code] = false; });
72: 
73:   // ----- Helper functions -----
74:   function spawnAsteroid() {
75:     const size = Math.random() * 30 + 20;
76:     asteroids.push({
77:       x: Math.random() * (W - size),
78:       y: -size,
79:       w: size,
80:       h: size,
81:       speed: 1 + Math.random() * 2 + score * 0.001
82:     });
83:   }
84: 
85:   function update() {
86:     if (gameOver) return;
87:     // Player movement
88:     if (keys['ArrowLeft']) player.x -= player.speed;
89:     if (keys['ArrowRight']) player.x += player.speed;
90:     player.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(W - player.w, player.x));
91: 
92:     // Shooting
93:     if (keys['Space'] && player.cooldown <= 0) {
94:       lasers.push({ x: player.x + player.w / 2 - 2, y: player.y, w: 4, h: 10, speed: 7 });
95:       player.cooldown = 15; // frames
96:       playTone(900, 0.08); // laser fire sound
97:     }
98:     if (player.cooldown > 0) player.cooldown--;
99: 
100:     // Update lasers
101:     for (let i = lasers.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
102:       const l = lasers[i];
103:       l.y -= l.speed;
104:       if (l.y + l.h < 0) lasers.splice(i, 1);
105:     }
106: 
107:     // Update particles (fade out)
108:     for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
109:       const p = particles[i];
110:       p.x += p.vx;
111:       p.y += p.vy;
112:       p.life--;
113:       if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
114:     }
115: 
116:     // Spawn asteroids periodically
117:     if (Math.random() < 0.02) spawnAsteroid();
118: 
119:     // Update asteroids
120:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
121:       const a = asteroids[i];
122:       a.y += a.speed;
123:       // collision with player
124:       if (a.x < player.x + player.w && a.x + a.w > player.x && a.y + a.h > player.y) {
125:         spawnExplosion(player.x + player.w / 2, player.y, '#ff0');
126:         gameOver = true;
127:       }
128:       // collision with lasers
129:       for (let j = lasers.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
130:         const l = lasers[j];
131:         if (l.x < a.x + a.w && l.x + l.w > a.x && l.y < a.y + a.h && l.y + l.h > a.y) {
132:           lasers.splice(j, 1);
133:           asteroids.splice(i, 1);
134:           score++;
135:           spawnExplosion(a.x + a.w / 2, a.y + a.h / 2, '#f55');
136:           break;
137:         }
138:       }
139:       // asteroid passes bottom
140:       if (a.y > H) {
141:         asteroids.splice(i, 1);
142:         // could reduce score or ignore; treat as missed
143:       }
144:     }
145:   }
146: 
147: function draw() {
148:     // Background starfield
149:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
150:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
151:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
152:     stars.forEach(s => ctx.fillRect(s.x, s.y, s.r, s.r));
153:     // Particles (explosions)
154:     particles.forEach(p => {
155:       ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
156:       ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(p.life / 30, 0);
157:       ctx.beginPath();
158:       ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
159:       ctx.fill();
160:     });
161:     ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
162:     // Player (triangle ship)
163:     ctx.fillStyle = player.color;
164:     ctx.beginPath();
165:     ctx.moveTo(player.x, player.y + player.h);
166:     ctx.lineTo(player.x + player.w / 2, player.y);
167:     ctx.lineTo(player.x + player.w, player.y + player.h);
168:     ctx.closePath();
169:     ctx.fill();
170:     // Lasers (glowing)
171:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0';
172:     lasers.forEach(l => {
173:       ctx.shadowColor = '#ff0';
174:       ctx.shadowBlur = 6;
175:       ctx.fillRect(l.x, l.y, l.w, l.h);
176:     });
177:     ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
178:     // Asteroids (circles with gradient)
179:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
180:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(a.x + a.w / 2, a.y + a.h / 2, a.w * 0.2, a.x + a.w / 2, a.y + a.h / 2, a.w / 2);
181:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#ff777');
182:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#aa0000');
183:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
184:       ctx.beginPath();
185:       ctx.arc(a.x + a.w / 2, a.y + a.h / 2, a.w / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
186:       ctx.fill();
187:     });
188:     // Score
189:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
190:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
191:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 20);
192:     // Game over overlay
193:     if (gameOver) {
194:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
195:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
196:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
197:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
198:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
199:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', W / 2, H / 2);
200:     }
201:   }
202:   }
203: 
204:   function loop() {
205:     if (!gameOver) update();
206:     draw();
207:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
208:   }
209: 
210:   // start the game
211:   loop();
212: })();

(End of file - total 212 lines)
</content>
